name: Mesmer
description:
Shapers of Belief, Architects of Doubt

Mesmers trade in illusions, half-truths, and the soft power of suggestion. Often dismissed as fashionable mystics or clever frauds, they are frequently the last to realize that their techniques are not merely persuasive—but magical.

By manipulating perception, emotion, and belief, Mesmers reshape reality at the level of the mind. Their magic bends thoughts, blurs senses, and plants ideas that feel self-generated. A Mesmer’s greatest victories often leave no visible scars, only altered memories and quiet doubts.

A Mesmer does not defeat you.
They convince you that you already have.

Domains of Magic

Mesmers command magic that targets perception, cognition, and identity:

  • Illusion: false images, invisibility, fabricated environments

  • Enchantment: charm, compulsion, domination, suggestion

  • Fear and confusion as weapons

  • Information warfare: scrying, telepathy, dream-intrusion

  • Truth and deception, deciding what is seen, remembered, or believed

Taboo: Honesty

Mesmers believe truth is mutable. Presenting reality plainly, when it could be framed to greater effect, feels irresponsible.

What people believe matters more than what is real.

Fault Lines

  • Feared by Votaries, distrusted by Witches, indulged by courts.

  • Rarely welcome where certainty is sacred.

novizio.description: You have learned or inherited a tradition of masked performance, deception, and dubious mysticism, practicing techniques that blur the line between clever trickery and genuine supernatural influence. You discover which techniques are genuine by experimentation.
